entries.en: And? Is it what I thought?
Got the data to prove it. Here. Listen for yourself.
entries.ro: Am și dovezile. Uite, ascultă-le și tu.

entries.en: Same spot as last time. Don't make me wait.
entries.ro: Același loc ca ultima dată. Nu mă lăsa să aștept.

entries.en: Dunno. Gonna have to ask him yourself.
entries.ro: Nu știu. O să-l întrebi chiar tu.

entries.en: Listen, dunno the detes, but Liam, he... he wants your engram. Wants to copy you.
entries.ro: Ascultă, nu știu detaliile, dar Liam, el... vrea engramul tău. Vrea să te copieze.

entries.en: No... No, I don't believe it. You hear me? Not a single word. You're lying.
entries.ro: Nu... Nu, nu cred. Mă auzi? Niciun cuvânt. Mă minți.

entries.en: Yeah, looks that way. Caught him in the VIP room with some chick. Ordered champagne.
entries.ro: Da, așa pare. L-am prins în camera VIP cu o tipă. A comandat șampanie.

entries.en: And? What did they talk about?
Can't say. Don't think they talked for long, though.
entries.ro: Nu pot spune. Nu cred că au vorbit mult, totuși.

entries.en: Mh. It's not much. But... it's enough.
entries.ro: Mh. Nu e mult. Dar... e suficient.

entries.en: No. Worse, Lizzy. Much, much worse.
entries.ro: Nu. Mai rău, Lizzy. Mult, mult mai rău.

entries.en: He said... he said he's afraid. For you. And... of you.
entries.en_m: He said... he said he's afraid. For you. And of you.
entries.ro: A zis... a zis că îi e frică. Pentru tine. Și... de tine.
